name: Silverback Breakfast and Cafe
notes: Own static HTML site, plain-text prices confirmed directly in curl'd bytes (no WebFetch summarization risk). Two tabs present in the same HTML: Breakfast and Lunch, each with their own pricing (e.g. Sides and kids items are cheaper on the Lunch tab, likely a lunch discount rather than markup - both are the restaurant's own numbers so both are recorded, sections tagged accordingly). Also pulled the separate Drinks menu page (own site). Reached: Classic Breakfasts, Omelets/Scramblers/Skillets, Batters, Eggs Benedicts, Grab and Go, Silverback Dishes, Senior Menu, Little Apes (kids) x2 dayparts, Sides x2 dayparts, Cold Sandwiches, Meltdowns, Burgers, Beverages, Kids Beverages. Not reached/omitted: the 'Fried Chicken' entree under Silverback Dishes has no single price (only priced as a combo with Pancakes/Waffles/French Toast at $17.95-$19.75) so it was dropped per the no-price rule rather than guessed.
